ruined.rulesText: **WAKE:** If your pawn is at this site, you may burn [favor-burnt] to place your pawn on any site.

intact.name: Hallowed Spring
intact.rulesText: When trading at this site for [secret], you **must** place both [favor] on the card you are trading with _(instead of burning one)_.

ruined.name: Hiding Place
ruined.rulesText: CHRONICLE (THRONE): This site's ruler may secretly keep a relic they have facedown. They start the next game with it.

intact.name: School of Vines
intact.rulesText: You may challenge a banner held by an enemy even if your pawn is not at their pawn's site.

ruined.name: Ruined School
ruined.rulesText: **SETUP (END) / WHEN EXPLORED:** Place [secret] on each site ruled by the bandits. _Players may take it in Wake._

intact.name: Oaken Fortress
intact.rulesText: While this card's ruler is at this site, they **cannot** be targeted by a challenge or a raid campaign. If ruled by Empire, all Imperials have this power.

ruined.name: Rotting Fortress
ruined.rulesText: Players at this site **cannot** be targeted by a challenge or a raid campaign, unless the targeting player has a [suit-beast] adviser.

intact.name: Forbidden Forest
intact.rulesText: Enemies of this card's ruler **cannot** travel to this site unless they have a [suit-beast] adviser.

ruined.name: Bandit Forest
ruined.rulesText: Imperials **cannot** place [favor] or [secret] on cards ruled by bandits or use their non-persistent powers.

intact.name: Forest Horn
intact.rulesText: [secret] [secret] **ACTION:** Choose a region. Discard all non-[suit-beast] denizens at sites in that region.

ruined.name: Broken Horn
ruined.rulesText: SETUP (END) / **WHEN EXPLORED:** Bury this region's discard pile.

legacies.name: Iron Hand
legacies.rulesText:
**If you are Imperial, discard Iron Hand.**

**SETUP:** If you were in the previous game, you place one warband on all sites coming from the Atlas until the Empire divider, and players may place their pawn at any site.

**CHRONICLE:** Score your legacies in addition to the winner, and perform Shape Empire and Build Edifice (Throne). Your sites are stored in place of the Empire (Stars).

legacies.name: Chronicler
legacies.rulesText: **CHRONICLE (SUN):** After Resolve Legacies, you may declare that all players score their legacies now. _Each legacy may only be scored once per game._

legacies.name: Steadfast
legacies.rulesText: **CHRONICLE:** Your other legacies **cannot** become dormant—they always stay active.

legacies.name: Peacemaker
legacies.rulesText: **ACTION:** Return a banner you hold to the shared bank. _Do not adjust its [favor] or [secret]._ If you do, remove all warbands except the last _(including bandits)_ from each site and player board, even yours.

legacies.name: The Needle
legacies.rulesText: After you take a banner in any way, you may flip it to its other side.

legacies.name: Circle of Swords
legacies.rulesText: **SETUP:** You gain eight starting warbands _(instead of three)_. If you're Imperial and other Imperials would gain fewer than three, you gain less.

legacies.name: Great Architect
legacies.rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** **CHRONICLE (THRONE):** You perform Build Edifice and may build any edifice _(not just a matching one)_. Do this even if the Iron Hand is in play.

legacies.name: Ancestral Lands
legacies.rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** **TRAVEL:** Traveling to the Cradle costs you only 1 Supply.

legacies.name: Scepter Bearer
legacies.rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** **SETUP:** You start with the Grand Scepter _(instead of the Chancellor)_.

legacies.name: Royal Line
legacies.rulesText: **IF YOU ARE A CITIZEN:** **CHRONICLE (SUN):** You may choose which Imperial meets the Successor goal. _Ignore the printed goal. You may choose no one._

legacies.name: Keeper of Order
legacies.rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** **BATTLE PLAN:** If your enemy is an Imperial, ±2 [attack-die] and you ignore all [skull] you roll when attacking.

legacies.name: Golden Key
legacies.rulesText: **IF YOU ARE AN IMPERIAL:** You may always peek at the Reliquary. **ACTION:** Burn [secret-burnt] [favor-burnt] to take a relic from the Reliquary.

legacies.name: World Crafter
legacies.rulesText: **SETUP:** For the Imperial Maps foundation, you fill site slots, using any mix of Recent and Forgotten Sites _(after resolving the Rival legacy)_. For the Wide Horizons foundation, when anyone explores, you fill the slot with a Recent or Forgotten Site.

legacies.name: Matchmaker
legacies.rulesText: Whenever players draw legacies from the deck and choose one to keep, you draw and choose for them instead. _The Amber Doors edifice does not trigger this._

legacies.name: Revolutionary
legacies.rulesText: **CHRONICLE (THRONE):** After Build Edifice, you may discard any number of denizens at Imperial sites.

legacies.name: Populist
legacies.rulesText: **SETUP:** When setting up the favor banks, you may choose to divide the favor among the banks evenly. If you do, take any remainder. _For example, dividing 19 favor among the banks leaves you one favor._

legacies.name: Rival
legacies.rulesText:
**CHRONICLE (THRONE):** In Shape Empire, you may prevent any number of denizens from being discarded.

**IF YOU ARE AN EXILE:** **SETUP:** Before resolving foundations, fill the three Cradlemost empty site slots using the Empire setup rules, but place one warband of yours on each _(not an Imperial warband)_. You may place your pawn on these sites.

legacies.name: The Ear
legacies.rulesText: **ACTION:** You may peek at the relics at any site. **CHRONICLE (THRONE):** In Scatter Relics, you examine the relics and choose which sites they go to.

legacies.name: High Priest
legacies.rulesText: **ACTION:** If you have the Darkest Secret, you may move any number of [secret] from the Darkest Secret to your player board. **WHEN NEGOTIATING:** You may give [secret].

legacies.name: Arbiter
legacies.rulesText: **END OF ROUND:** Before the end die is rolled, you may choose to modify the roll by −1 to +3.

legacies.name: The Standard Bearer
legacies.rulesText: **SETUP:** After placing your pawn, you may take a banner from the shared bank and place two more [favor] or [secret] on it from the shared bank.

legacies.name: Heirloom
legacies.rulesText: **CHRONICLE (THRONE):** Before Scatter Relics, secretly choose one of your relics to keep facedown. You will start the next game with it.

legacies.name: Seer
legacies.rulesText: **SETUP:** When building the world deck, peek at the Visions and secretly place them in any positions.

legacies.name: The Bright Beacon
legacies.rulesText: **CHRONICLE (BEACON):** If you're resolving the Beacon, you may take any six cards from the Dispossessed _(instead of choosing suits and taking from their matching dividers)_.

legacies.name: Oaths of Loyalty
legacies.rulesText: When you would gain a starting adviser, bury it, except for—**CHRONICLE (WORLD):** In Gather Denizens, keep your faceup advisers. They will be your facedown starting advisers in the next game.

legacies.name: Conspirator
legacies.rulesText: **WAKE:** On your first turn, secretly write down which round the game will end on and who will win. If you are correct, you win instead. _This even beats a Successor win._

legacies.name: Light Fingers
legacies.rulesText: **WAKE:** When you Take Wealth, you may take [favor] or [secret] from your site even if enemy pawns are there.

legacies.name: Secret Society
legacies.rulesText: **SETUP:** Before building the world deck, you may secretly choose a Vision except the Conspiracy to take as a facedown adviser _(discard excess advisers)_. If you do, advance the Visions Drawn marker once.

legacies.name: Ruthless
legacies.rulesText: **ACTION:** Burn [favor-burnt] [favor-burnt] to bury a denizen at your site.

legacies.name: Quest to Distant Lands
legacies.rulesText: **SETUP:** You may choose to not place your pawn. If you do, you may choose one card from the Dispossessed and swap it with a starting adviser or card you drew in Foundation IV. _It is not buried by the Oaths of Loyalty legacy._ **WAKE:** On your first turn, you **must** place your pawn at any site.

legacies.name: Wealthy
legacies.rulesText: Set Foundation II to Movers and Shakers. **SETUP:** After placing your pawn, take [favor] from two players or take [favor] [favor] [favor] from the shared bank.

legacies.name: Gatekeeper
legacies.rulesText: Set Foundation III to Public Ambitions. **CHRONICLE (SUN):** Before players resolve legacies, you may take one active legacy from an enemy if you meet its goal.

legacies.name: Beloved
legacies.rulesText: Set Foundation IV to Teeming World. **WHEN TRADING:** You may trade with advisers held by other players whose pawns are at your site.

legacies.name: The Mouth
legacies.rulesText: Set Foundation VI to Festival. **ACTION:** Burn [favor-burnt] [favor-burnt] to activate a dormant legacy if you meet its goal. _You can even activate legacies in the Public Ambitions foundation._

legacies.name: Reformer
legacies.rulesText: Set Foundation V to Grand Council. **CHRONICLE (START OF THRONE):** If you won, you may move and swap denizens at sites you rule, ignoring the locked restriction.

legacies.name: Pathfinder
legacies.rulesText: Set Foundation I to Wide Horizons. **TRAVEL:** You may ignore the Mountain, Island, and Pass powers.
